plan: Given my private value of $19, I should bid below this amount to ensure a profit if I win. Bidding exactly $19 or more risks no profit or a loss if I win. I will bid slightly lower to increase the chance of winning while maintaining profitability. Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I will bid $18.9, which is high enough to potentially win but ensures a profit margin if I win and pay the third-highest bid.

Given my value of $3, bidding more than $3 would result in a potential loss if I win, as I would pay the third-highest bid. Since all values are drawn independently and equally likely, I should bid $0 to avoid a loss, as any bid over $3 is dominated.

Given my value of $47, I aim to bid close to this value to maximize potential profit while ensuring I don't overbid. Bidding slightly below $47, such as $46.9, avoids dominated bids and balances winning chances with profit retention. This strategy accounts for the possibility of others bidding close to their values and ensures I pay the third-highest bid, maximizing net gain.
